{"fetched_at":"2026-06-12","jd_text":"Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
Location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role
As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic’s products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities
- Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
- Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic’s GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
- Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
- Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
- Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
- Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic’s products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have
- 7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
- 3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
- Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
- Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
- Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
- A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have
- 5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
- Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience.
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience.
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position.
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, Anthropic expects all staff to be in one of its offices at least 25% of the time. Some roles may require more time in office.
Visa sponsorship: Anthropic says it sponsors visas but cannot successfully sponsor every role and candidate.

targeting_context.briefing:
# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s opportunity is to turn frontier-model capability into dependable enterprise outcomes through an ecosystem that can deliver with consistency, speed, and sound judgment.

The central operating challenge is balancing reusable implementation patterns with the variation of real customer environments. Partners need enough autonomy to create momentum, while Anthropic must protect quality, security, and its
responsible-AI position.

This is a leverage role: a strong partner technical function can expand enterprise reach without requiring every customer outcome to depend on direct vendor involvement. The lasting value is an operating system that turns field learning
into
repeatable adoption.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a San Francisco-based public benefit corporation focused on AI safety and research. Its stated orientation emphasizes systems that are dependable, understandable, and controllable.

The company combines frontier research, a commercial AI platform, developer-facing capabilities, and enterprise adoption requirements. Claude is the principal product surface, while trustworthiness and model behavior remain core elements
of how the company presents itself.

Anthropic must grow enterprise usage without drifting into an unscalable bespoke-services model. That makes clear implementation guidance, practical governance, shared technical assets, and effective escalation mechanisms important
commercial infrastructure.

The fundamental tension is reach versus control. Ecosystem growth broadens adoption, but it also increases the need for consistent technical standards and a disciplined way to surface product gaps from deployments.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Claude is positioned for complex knowledge work, including analysis, software development, and problem solving. That gives Anthropic a broad enterprise value proposition, but broad capability alone does not create durable production
outcomes.

The company’s public-benefit orientation distinguishes its commercial posture. Enterprise growth must remain aligned with expectations around reliability, security, appropriate use, and transparency about system limitations.

The strategic pressure is to make platform value practical across diverse industries, workflows, and buyer environments. A mature ecosystem motion requires decisions about which patterns should be self-guided, which require expert
involvement, and which deployment lessons should become product improvements.

Success in this environment is not merely technical credibility on individual opportunities. It is the ability to make effective solution approaches portable across partner firms, customer accounts, and market segments.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic describes a cross-functional organization spanning research, engineering, policy, and business functions. Enterprise adoption work therefore likely operates across meaningful technical, commercial, and responsible-use
boundaries.

No individual executive ownership for this organization is confirmed in the available research. The relevant stakeholder map is functional:

- Research and safety functions help preserve standards for dependable and responsible product use.
- Product and engineering teams determine which field patterns can become scalable platform capabilities.
- Commercial and alliance organizations need technically credible paths from customer interest to successful adoption.
- Cloud, technology, and services firms extend market reach while generating high-value deployment feedback.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is Anthropic’s principal AI offering and is presented as a tool for demanding work across business and technical contexts. Anthropic also maintains a strong research identity centered on the behavior, safety, and usefulness of AI
systems.

The architectural implication is that enterprise adoption should not be treated as basic model access. Customers need a path from capability evaluation to workflow design, integration, operational readiness, and measurable business value.

Reusable guidance is strategically important: well-defined patterns can reduce delivery variance, accelerate implementation, and provide common language across internal teams and external firms.

Anthropic’s research orientation raises the bar for practical field judgment. Technical messaging should connect safety-minded principles to real architecture decisions, customer constraints, and product usage rather than becoming
research-heavy in commercial settings.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly identifies a network across cloud, technology, and services partners. This supports an ecosystem-led route to enterprise adoption rather than a solely direct selling model.

The ecosystem has several complementary paths:

- Cloud providers create access through infrastructure, procurement, and enterprise technology environments.
- Technology firms can extend Claude within adjacent products and customer experiences.
- Services organizations can turn platform capability into implementation, workflow redesign, and organizational change.

The operating need is a coordinated commercial and delivery model, not a simple referral channel. External teams need clear qualification criteria, practical solution guidance, credible enablement, and known points for escalation.

The most valuable shared asset is a repeatable solution pattern that can move across accounts and partner practices. Domain-specific use cases matter because enterprise value often emerges through concrete workflows rather than generic AI
demonstrations.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s public narrative combines a broad enterprise-use proposition for Claude with an expanding network of cloud, technology, and services collaborators.

That combination creates pressure to mature partner technical operations. As adoption occurs through more routes, uneven solution quality, unclear engagement rules, and fragmented feedback can slow momentum and weaken customer confidence.

Enterprise AI competition is increasingly shaped by implementation readiness. Buyers need more than model performance; they need credible routes to secure, governed, useful deployment. Anthropic’s ecosystem can be a differentiator if
partner capability grows alongside technical quality.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Scaling partner technical capability without creating a custom-delivery bottleneck.
- Creating portable enterprise AI patterns that improve speed, quality, and adoption confidence.
- Designing practical co-sell, technical validation, and escalation mechanisms across ecosystem routes.
- Converting implementation insight from customers and partners into clear platform priorities.
- Pairing commercial momentum with robust expectations for security, reliability, and responsible use.
- Developing technical leaders who teach effectively, influence senior stakeholders, and build leverage through enablement.
- Translating sophisticated AI capability into business-relevant workflows and implementation choices.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- The compelling problem is making high-quality Claude implementations repeatable when delivery occurs through external firms.
- Anthropic’s safety-centered identity makes technical enablement a strategic quality mechanism, not simply product education.
- Partner architecture connects enterprise growth, customer outcomes, platform learning, and responsible deployment.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, achievements, leadership scope, technical depth, and outcomes must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
